_comment: Cookie Run OvenBreak — auto Send-Life from the Mailbox > Lives tab. Different screen/flow from sendlife.json (that one drives the home-screen Friends tab list); this one drives the Mailbox popup instead. Precondition: Mailbox open, Lives tab selected (the 'Received Lives are stored for 3 days.' list with per-friend 'Receive & Send' rows and the green 'Quick Receive & Send Lives' banner at the bottom). One tap on that banner opens a 'Send <name> a free Life?' confirm dialog (some friends show an extra '(+3 Gift Points)' line, some don't — live-verified both variants 2026-08-01); tapping Confirm sends it AND immediately re-opens the same dialog for the next friend in the list — no extra 'Message sent' popup in between. So the loop only needs to keep confirming until the dialog stops reappearing (list exhausted). SPEED-TUNED 2026-08-01: poll_ms and waits trimmed after live timing showed the dialog re-opens within ~500-700ms of a Confirm tap. All coords/templates verified live @1920x1080.

mailbox_base._note: Lives tab visible, no send-life dialog yet — tap the Quick Receive & Send Lives banner once to kick off the confirm chain. tap_template (not a fixed tap_xy) so the tap follows wherever the banner actually renders, and every tap already gets engine-level spatial jitter + randomized delay (src/act.py _jitter) — no two taps land on the exact same pixel or land at the exact same interval.

confirm_loop._note: Marker is the Cancel+Confirm button ROW, not the dialog text — text-based detection broke live: some friends' dialog has no '(+3 Gift Points)' line at all, so a marker cropped from that line scored 0.42 (absent) on those and the bot falsely concluded the list was exhausted after 0 sends (caught 2026-08-01, wint3r's dialog had no Gift Points line). The button row is identical across every dialog variant (name-agnostic AND gift-points-agnostic) — scores 1.000 on both. Present -> tap Confirm via tap_template (jittered position + delay, per-poll fresh timing from poll_ms range) -> the same dialog re-opens for the next friend within ~500-700ms, so we just loop back and re-check. absent_retries tolerates the brief re-open gap without falsely concluding the list is done.

done._note: List exhausted -> the 'All Lives received and sent!' popup fires (live-verified 2026-08-01, hearts went 495->726 confirming real sends, not a false-absent). Close it via Confirm so the run always ends on a clean Lives-tab screen, not a stray popup blocking the next launch. Absent (e.g. dialog stopped reappearing for some other reason, popup already gone) -> stop directly.
